observations: body L5, L7: the hamza of «أشْكَالُ» (L7) has no fatḥa, unlike «أَشْكَالٌ» (L5); the round mark over its shīn is the sukūn of this type, not a damma.
body L6: the o of «eo» is printed as two separate arcs; transcribed as the letter.
body L7, L31: the alif after the article in «الٱتِّصَالَاتِ» (L7) and «صَدْرُ ٱلكِتَابِ» (L31) carries the waṣla (4.2-4.3 by 2.2-2.3 points); transcribed ٱ, as on p. 339.
body L10, L33, L35: the doubled rho of «ὑπόκιῤῥος» (L10), «ἀποῤῥέων» (L33) and «ἀπόῤῥοια» (L35) is printed with the smooth breathing on the first rho and the rough breathing on the second.
body L13: the headword «شِهْرٌ» is printed with a kasra under the shīn, a sukūn over the hāʾ and a dammatān over the rāʾ.
body L15: «إصْبَعٌ» is printed with the hamza under the alif and without a kasra. The first reference is «٣٣» of two digits, each with two crests (4.8 points), not ٢٣٣.
body L22: a speck (0.6 point) is printed before «« addidimus»; not transcribed. The dots of «addidimus ...» are printed spaced; transcribed «...».

body L25, L27: the final hamza of «جزْء» (L25) is the plain sort (4.0 by 3.1 points); «صحيحةً» (L27) has a fatḥatān on the tāʾ marbūṭa; the other words of both quotations are unvowelled except the shadda of «ممّا».
body L27: the comma after the Arabic quotation is the Latin comma, set after the run in the order of the Latin text.
body L32: the last reference is «٢٢٥»: its first two digits have one crest each (3.1 and 2.9 points), unlike the 3 of «٢٠٣» in the same line, which has two (4.8 points).
body L34: «اِتِّصَال» has a kasra under the alif and one under the tāʾ, whose shadda stands above without a vowel.
body L35: «alnisigref» is the form printed in the Latin version of Plato of Tivoli; transcribed as printed.
